name: LAS-51
source:
Silas - or Living Artificial Synthezoid no. 51, as he's first introduced - is the android who rescues you at the start of the game. As a laborer-class android, he is analytical and pragmatic, pursuing his goals with single-minded focus... In this case, his first and foremost objective is to ensure your continued health and safety. Programmed without the benefit of a social-sensitivity chip, Silas is also somewhat blunt and lacking in empathy. This may make for a few awkward moments along your journey with him, particularly if you find yourself attracted to his eerily-elegant features and inhumanly blue eyes...

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=43782]Lemma Soft Forum thread[/url]]
